# Introduction

# Methods
## Load necessary libraries
```{r load_libraries}
library(rgdal)
library(sp)
library(rgeos)
library(mapproj)
library(leaflet)
library(googlesheets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(broom)
library(geosphere)
library(raster)
```
## Load anti-shipping activity messages
```{r load_data, results='hide',error=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
## load anti-shipping data
ASAM <- readOGR(dsn = "data/ASAM_shp", layer = "ASAM 18 JAN 17", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

## read in EEZ
eez <- readOGR(dsn = "data/World_EEZ_v9_20161021_LR", layer = "eez_lr", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

## set world base map
world <- map("world", fill = TRUE, plot = FALSE)
```
## Plot data

```{r plot}
piracy <- ASAM %>%
         subset(ASAM@data$Aggressor == "Pirates")
leaflet(data = world) %>%
  # fitBounds(0, 60, 35, 72) %>%
  addPolygons(
    stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 1, smoothFactor = 1, color = "white"
  )  %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = eez,
    group = "eez",
    stroke=TRUE,
    weight=1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>EEZ: </b>", GeoName, "<br>")) %>%
  addMarkers(
    data = piracy,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Date: </b>", DateOfOcc, "<br>",
      "<b>Victim: </b>", Victim, "<br>",
      "<b>Description: </b>", paste0(Desc1,Desc2,sep=" "), "<br>"))
```
